item.title: IRGC says it shot down US-made drone near Hormuz Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
IRGC says it shot down US-made drone near Hormuz Strait of Hormuz

Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced that it downed an MQ-1 drone in the airspace east of the Strait of Hormuz, state media reported. 

"The 14th advanced MQ1 drone was intercepted and destroyed by the Revolutionary Guard's new advanced aerospace defense system, under the control of the country's integrated air defense network, in the sky east of the Strait of Hormuz (opposite Sirik)," the announcement carried by IRNA read.

item.title: Thames Water creditors to vote on emergency £2.4bn loan as cash runs low
item.description:
Campaigners say costly new funds will lead to higher bills, which company denies

A group of creditors to troubled Thames Water are poised to vote on whether to grant an emergency £2.4bn loan to keep the company afloat, as campaigners raise concerns it could add £40 to each household’s bills in interest alone.

A consortium of creditors, called London & Valley Water, will vote on Thursday on whether to increase a funding facility for the debt-laden utility company to £5.4bn to keep it operating to autumn 2027.

item.title: Obama slams Trump's handling of war on Iran and its toll on the US
item.description:
Obama slams Trump's handling of war on Iran and its toll on the US

Former US president Barack Obama has criticised Donald Trump for his policy in the war on Iran and the toll its had. 

" I didn’t have to fire any missiles. I engaged in diplomacy," he said. 

Refering to the toll of the war on Washington, Obama said: "Our allies and bases have been attacked. Americans have been killed. Hundreds of Americans have been wounded. We have run down our stock of missiles, making us more vulnerable, and Iran now has veto power over the Strait of Hormuz."

The fiormer American president added that this is the "reason why the price of oil is up".

Obama added, “This is the reason why the price of oil is up.”

item.description:
Trump says US 'didn’t start this war' on Iran

US president Donald Trump has claimed that the "didn’t start this war" on Iran, adding that the conflict "should have been taken care of long before I came here".

In late February, Israel and the US launched their war on Iran, despite the Oman-brokered talks at the time centered around Tehran’s nuclear programme.

US-Israeli attacks were also carried out against Iran last year during ongoing discussions.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition claims it destroyed Houthi ballistic missile fired towards kingdom
item.description:
Saudi-led coalition claims it destroyed Houthi ballistic missile fired towards kingdom

The Saudi-Led coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the Houthis towards Saudi Arabia's eastern region early on Thursday.

Meanwhile, the Saudi civil defence issued two alerts warning of potential danger in Najran and in the Eastern Province, before saying minutes later that the danger had passed in both areas.

item.title: Albania imposes $6,000 fine for demonstrators present at a protest that turns violent
item.description:
The fine – six times the average monthly salary – will apply to people present at violent protests, even if they don’t personally commit violent acts

Albania has introduced fines of more than $6,000 for demonstrators who participate in a protest that turns violent, even if they don’t personally commit violent acts, as the government tries to clamp down on the gatherings calling for the prime minister’s resignation.

The capital, Tirana, has been racked by months of anti-government protests that in recent days have deteriorated into pitched battles between the security forces and protesters.

item.description:

  • Budget 2026: key points at a glance

  • Briefing: key questions answered by Heather Stewart and Pippa Crerar

  • Editorial: Budget’s bold ambitions and welcome first steps

John Healey raised taxes on banks and landlords to fund a £100 winter handout for 20 million families as official forecasts made clear there is no end in sight for the cost of living crisis.

In his first budget, the chancellor blamed “global economic storms” for the grim outlook, as the war in Iran drives up oil and gas prices.

The case in question centers on Shayna Feinman, who was reported missing in rural Yavapai county, Arizona, in March 2024 at age 38.
